name: Adopt and Raise
desc:
🚀 Exciting News: Rework Coming 🚀

We're thrilled to announce that the game is undergoing a major transformation! We've been hard at work remaking our old 2018 title from the ground up, and the time is almost at hand!

What's in store for you guys: 
🏡 New Homes: Bigger, better homes, and with more interactive stuff!
🚗 Vehicles: Cars are finally being added!
💇 Avatar Editor: Completely new, modern avatar editor!
🔧 Major bug fixes & improvements!
👪 Families & Player interactions!
... And much, much more!

📣 NOTICE: Development was delayed due to member changes in the team. We're working on getting back on track ASAP. We're now aiming for a Spring release. Thank you for your continued support and patience!

See you soon! 🎉
